environment.execution: isolated development environment, not user Windows repository

initial_validation_issue.finding: Canonical release fingerprints reject float values; first V20 targeted run exposed 25 failures caused by percentage/cost floats.
initial_validation_issue.remediation: Redesigned governed percentages as integer basis points and monetary values as integer cents; no relaxation of canonical fingerprint rules.

notes: V19 rights authorization remains a prerequisite; V20 operational fitness cannot override missing rights.
PASS means evidence is technically sufficient for governed review, not that a provider is contractually or legally certified.
The isolated test count must not be represented as the user repository test count until a consolidated installer is run and verified on the user machine.
scope: Provider Portfolio, SLA, Quality, Latency, Quota, Cost & Failover Governance
